auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to your AURA station.
auth.signupSubtitle: Start your 7-day Pro trial in under a minute.
auth.marketingOptIn: I want product updates, tips, and offers from AURA. Unsubscribe anytime — transactional emails (password reset, bulletins) ship regardless.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter the account email. We'll send a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSentBody: If that account exists, we just sent a link to set a new password. Check your inbox — and the spam folder, just in case.
auth.resetSubtitle: Pick a strong password. At least 8 characters.

errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
errors.ipLimit: We've seen several signups from this network recently. Wait a few days or contact us so we can unlock it manually.
errors.invalidToken: The reset link is invalid. Please request a new one.
errors.expiredToken: The reset link expired (valid for 1 hour). Please request a new one.

onboarding.planSubtitle: All plans start with a 7-day Pro trial. You'll only be charged after the trial.

newsPage.title: Search the news
newsPage.subtitle: Pick categories, bias, and runtime — AURA pulls trusted sources and shapes a bulletin to fit.
newsPage.weatherCityHint: Forecast will be for this city.
newsPage.weatherCityRequired: Type a city — without it, weather won't be included in the bulletin.
newsPage.transitionEffectsHint: Inserts ~1.2s of silence between distinct stories so each one breathes.
newsPage.searchHint: Configure the parameters and click search.
newsPage.noResults: No articles found. Try different filters.
newsPage.errorGeneric: Couldn't reach the news service. Please try again.
newsPage.errorQuota: You hit today's bulletin limit. Upgrade or wait until tomorrow.
newsPage.errorInvalidInput: Check the {field} field — the value isn't accepted.

bulletin.scriptEmpty: Your script will appear here once generated.
bulletin.overagePrompt: You hit today's bulletin limit. Generate this one anyway for ${price}?
bulletin.overageTrial: You hit your trial's daily limit. Upgrade to Pro to keep going.
bulletin.bgTrackHint: Pick a local audio file. It is mixed in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
bulletin.musicLocked: AI background tracks are a Pro-only feature.
bulletin.musicLockedHint: Upgrade to generate custom tracks tuned to the bulletin's emotions.
bulletin.musicAiHint: AURA composes an instrumental track tuned to the script's emotions and bulletin duration. It is mixed under the voice.
bulletin.musicOveragePrompt: You're out of monthly tracks. Generate one more for US$ {price}?
bulletin.errorMix: Could not mix the background track. The voice-only version is available below.

analyticsPage.title: Analytics
analyticsPage.subtitle: How your station uses AURA — picks per language, voice, and topic.
analyticsPage.emptyBody: Generate a few bulletins and come back — metrics light up as soon as data arrives.
analyticsPage.errorLoad: Couldn't load analytics. Refresh to retry.

automationsPage.title: Automations
automationsPage.subtitle: Schedule recurring bulletins. AURA pulls news, writes the script, and ships audio on its own.
automationsPage.listHelp: Each automation runs the picked categories at every configured time.
automationsPage.editorSubtitle: Times use the schedule's timezone. Each slot can target different categories.
automationsPage.lockedTitle: Scheduling is a Standard or Pro feature
automationsPage.lockedBody: Upgrade to schedule daily bulletins, attach a background track, and run automation across the day.
automationsPage.emptyBody: Create one to start receiving daily bulletins on autopilot.
automationsPage.name: Automation name
automationsPage.durationHint: Total target runtime per bulletin (30–600 seconds).
automationsPage.weatherHint: Fetched at run time. Set the city below.
automationsPage.weatherCityHint: Forecast will be for this city.
automationsPage.weatherCityRequired: Type a city — without it, weather won't be included in the bulletin.
automationsPage.transitionEffectsHint: Inserts ~1.2s of silence between distinct stories so each one breathes.
automationsPage.enabledHint: Toggle to pause without losing the schedule.
automationsPage.confirmDeleteBody: All scheduled runs will stop immediately. Already-generated audios are preserved.
automationsPage.errorSave: Couldn't save. Check the form and try again.
automationsPage.errorRun: Couldn't run this automation right now.
automationsPage.runsEmptyBody: Once the cron picks up this automation, executions show up here.
automationsPage.runsSlotMissing: The slot for this run has been removed from the automation.
automationsPage.deliveryNone: No destination — stays in My Audios
automationsPage.folderReady: Default folder configured — downloads land there.
automationsPage.folderNotConfigured: No default folder. Pick one to download without a prompt.
automationsPage.bgTrackUploadHint: MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC or M4A file up to 15 MB. Hosted for reuse across runs.
automationsPage.bgTrackAiHint: AURA composes an instrumental track that will be reused on every run of this automation.
automationsPage.musicLocked: AI tracks are a Pro-only feature.
automationsPage.musicOveragePrompt: You're out of monthly tracks. Generate one more for US$ {price}?

audiosPage.title: My audios
audiosPage.subtitle: Every bulletin you generate is here for replay, edit and download.
audiosPage.emptyBody: Head to News Search to create your first bulletin.
audiosPage.confirmDeleteBody: The MP3 and its script will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.
audiosPage.errorLoad: Couldn't load your audios. Please refresh.
audiosPage.errorDelete: Couldn't delete this audio. Try again.
audiosPage.errorDownload: Couldn't download right now. Try again.
audiosPage.confirmBulkDeleteBody: The MP3s and scripts will be removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
audiosPage.errorBulkDelete: {failed} audio(s) couldn't be deleted. The others were removed.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Station info, plan, preferences.
settingsPage.emailNotificationsHint: Trial reminders, billing receipts, and important account updates.
settingsPage.billingHint: Change plan, view invoices, manage payment method.
settingsPage.deliveryHint: Where AURA drops each bulletin — playout FTP, RSS feed, webhook, email.
settingsPage.brandHint: Replace AURA's logo and accent color with your station's identity.
settingsPage.usersHint: See who signed up, who's trialing, who converted — and export leads as CSV.
settingsPage.healthHint: Verify ElevenLabs, Anthropic, news, weather, and storage are reachable. Tests run live.
settingsPage.errorSave: Couldn't save your changes. Try again.
settingsPage.downloadFolderHint: When configured, downloaded and synced bulletins go straight to this folder without a prompt.
settingsPage.downloadFolderUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support the direct folder API. Firefox and Safari fall back to a regular download.

healthPage.title: Integration health
healthPage.subtitle: Live probes for every external service AURA depends on. Use this when something looks off, or right after rotating an API key.
healthPage.ttsTestHint: Plays a one-second ElevenLabs preview using the first seeded voice. If you hear audio, the API key and the voice catalog are correctly wired.
healthPage.errorNoVoice: No voices found. Run `bun run db:seed` to populate the catalog first.
healthPage.errorPreview: Couldn't play the preview. Check the ElevenLabs row below for the exact error.
healthPage.explanation: Probes are read-only and only run when you open this page or hit a retry button. Failure messages include the upstream HTTP status when available — 401 means the key is wrong, 429 means rate-limited, 5xx means upstream is degraded.

deliveryPage.title: Bulletin destinations
deliveryPage.subtitle: Choose where AURA drops each generated bulletin so it lands inside your station's infrastructure.
deliveryPage.listHelp: Active destinations receive a copy of every automation run, straight into your setup.
deliveryPage.feedHint: Paste this link into the podcast catcher of your playout system (Zetta, NexGen, RCS, AudioVault, etc.). Every new bulletin gets pulled in automatically.
deliveryPage.feedRotateTooltip: Generate a new URL and invalidate the current one
deliveryPage.feedConfirmRotateBody: The current link stops working immediately. You'll need to update the link in your playout system.
deliveryPage.editorSubtitle: Credentials are encrypted in the database.
deliveryPage.lockedBody: Upgrade to Pro and AURA drops each bulletin directly into your station's FTP, webhook, or inbox the moment it finishes generating.
deliveryPage.emptyBody: Add one so bulletins land in your station automatically — no manual download.
deliveryPage.name: Name
deliveryPage.localFolderHelp: AURA writes each bulletin straight into a folder on your computer while this tab is open. Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera.
deliveryPage.localFolderTabHint: Keep AURA open in a tab on the PC that receives the audios. If the tab closes, bulletins wait and sync the next time you open it.
deliveryPage.localFolderUnsupported: This browser can't write to a local folder. Use Chrome, Edge, Brave, or Opera.
deliveryPage.confirmDeleteBody: Future automations will stop landing here. Past bulletins are unaffected.
deliveryPage.errorSave: Couldn't save the destination. Check the fields and try again.
deliveryPage.errorDelete: Couldn't remove the destination. Try again.

brandPage.title: Branding
brandPage.subtitle: Pro stations can replace AURA's wordmark and accent with their own identity.
brandPage.logoHint: PNG or SVG, transparent background. Max height 32px in the sidebar.
brandPage.accentHint: Used for primary buttons, active links, and progress bars. Falls back to teal if blank.
brandPage.lockedBody: Upgrade to Pro to white-label AURA with your station's logo and accent color.

voicesPage.title: My voices
voicesPage.subtitle: Preview the catalog, pick a default. Locked voices unlock with Standard or Pro.
voicesPage.speedHint: Used when no per-bulletin speed is set. Range 0.80x–1.50x.
voicesPage.upgradeForMore: Upgrade to Pro to unlock the full voice catalog and custom voice cloning.
voicesPage.errorLoad: Couldn't load the voice catalog. Please refresh.
voicesPage.errorPreview: Couldn't play the preview right now.
voicesPage.errorSave: Couldn't save your voice preference. Try again.
voicesPage.cloneSectionBody: Upload 1–5 clean samples (30–60s each) and AURA creates a custom voice via ElevenLabs.

clone.title: Clone a voice
clone.modalHelp: Upload 1–5 audio samples. Best results: 30–60 seconds of clean speech per sample.
clone.name: Voice name
clone.samplesHint: Drop or click to add MP3/WAV files
clone.samplesNote: Max 11MB per file. ElevenLabs Instant Voice Clone API will be used.
clone.errorNoFiles: Please select at least one audio sample.

billing.errorPortalUnavailable: Couldn't open the billing portal. Try again in a moment.
billing.errorChangeFailed: Couldn't change plan. Please try again.
